issue_context.title: Parse Pod's Node affinity once in PreFilter and PreScore
issue_context.body:
We currently parse Pod's Node Affinity every time during Filter or Score.
These are wasteful computations that can be done once in PreFilter or PreScore.

Note that an error in Filter needs to be reported lazily (if no terms match), to preseve backwards compatibility.

/sig scheduling
